@read_laneTerminal : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool) (encNat : ℕ → Fin m → Bool),
  (∀ (k : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length), enc k = encNat ↑k) →
    ∀ (gamma : Ext6L) (r : Fin m → Ext6L),
      readExt6 (laneTerminal gamma r encNat (descriptorResiduals d wv)) =
        mle (gammaResidualTable d wv enc (readExt6 gamma)) fun i => readExt6 (r i)
@mle_gammaResidualTable_sparse : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6Q) (r : Fin m → Ext6Q),
  mle (gammaResidualTable d wv enc gamma) r =
    ∑ k, gamma ^ ↑k * (algebraMap BabyBear Ext6Q) ((descriptorResiduals d wv).get k) * chiEval (enc k) r
@realize_sound : ∀ {Root Op : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Root] {n m : ℕ} (S : BindingCommitment Root BabyBear (Fin n) Op)
  (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (encNat : ℕ → Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6L) (r : Fin m → Ext6L)
  (w : Fin n → BabyBear) (op : Opening n) (v : Ext6L),
  realize (↑S).commit d encNat gamma r ((↑S).commit w) op = Except.ok v →
    ∀ (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)).length ↪ Fin m → Bool),
      (∀ (k : Fin (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)).length), enc k = encNat ↑k) →
        readExt6 v = mle (gammaResidualTable d (traceOf w) enc (readExt6 gamma)) fun i => readExt6 (r i)
